why_agent_cannot: find the official site from the project's own profile
what_human_must_do: No official domain was extracted. Find it from the project's own profile first.
steps_from_source: Check the restricted list first. OmenX blocks 36 countries and regions, among them the United States, the United Kingdom, Canada, Germany, France, Italy, the Netherlands, Singapore, Hong Kong, mainland China, Japan and Australia. Its terms forbid getting around the block.
Open omenx.com and sign in with Google, Telegram or a wallet.
Complete your profile with a username and an email address you confirm by code.
Open Rewards to see the task list, your referral link and your points.

To trade, deposit USDC using the asset, network and address the app shows. Warning Send only what the deposit screen asks for. The app warns that "deposits of other assets or from other networks will be lost".
Choose a Standard or Boost market, read its rules and place a YES or NO order. The minimum order is 2 USDC.
